status.liveHint: Changes show up the moment they happen.
status.offHint: This server runs without live updates — the page refreshes itself every few seconds.
status.errorHint: The page will keep refreshing itself every few seconds.

presence.label: Here right now
presence.nobody: Nobody else is here right now
presence.one: {name} is looking at this board too
presence.many: {name} and {count} others are looking at this board

share.title: Share this canvas
share.description: A copy of your private canvas appears on the project or event page. The original stays private.
share.privacyNote: Sharing makes a copy. Later changes to your private canvas don't reach it — you edit the copy from here. You can take the share back at any moment.
share.targetPlaceholder: Choose a project or an event
share.allowEditHelp: Turn this off and they only look — no cursors either.

noTargets.title: Nowhere to share it
noTargets.body: Join a project or sign up for an event first.

revoke.confirmBody: The copy closes for everyone. Nothing happens to your private canvas.

cursors.label: Live cursors
cursors.nobody: Nobody else is on this canvas right now

conflict.title: Somebody changed this canvas before you
conflict.body: The newest version is loaded. Make your change again.

empty.title: This canvas isn't shared yet
empty.body: Share it and the people in that project or event can look at it and edit it with you.

error.title: Couldn't open the canvas
error.body: Something went wrong with the connection. Try again.

forbidden.title: This canvas isn't open to you
forbidden.body: Only the people in the project or event it was shared to can see it.
